title: Tucker matrix-bank Mirror layer coefficients
hypothesis: Across four Transformer blocks, replacing free rank-2 Tucker coefficients for each repeated block matrix with a shared-center, shared-radius circular Mirror view plus one angle per layer will reduce the complete serialized inference payload by at least 5% while increasing fresh character-level validation NLL by no more than 0.02 nat/token versus free rank-2 Tucker coefficients.
mirror_insertion: For each repeated nanoGPT block matrix family (attention QKV, attention output, MLP expansion, MLP output), represent each layer matrix by a shared mean plus a shared rank-2 matrix bank applied to a layer coefficient. The Mirror constraint writes that coefficient as shared 2D center plus one shared radius times [cos(angle_l), sin(angle_l)].

task.dataset: Tiny Shakespeare character corpus from karpathy/char-rnn, fetched by pinned SHA-256; 80/10/10 sequential train/development/fresh split
task.model: third_party/nanoGPT GPT; 4 layers, 4 heads, embedding 64, context 64, dropout 0, character vocabulary
task.training: 500 AdamW updates, batch 32, fixed learning rate 0.001, 1 CPU thread; independent baseline per seed
task.selection: No hyperparameter selection is allowed. Development evaluates only the middle 10% Tiny Shakespeare split. Fresh seeds and independent Gutenberg audit remain unopened until amended source and protocol are committed.
task.fresh_audit_corpus: Project Gutenberg eBook 1342, Pride and Prejudice; raw SHA-256 captured at first valid fresh access; normalize fixed quotes/dashes, retain only frozen Tiny Shakespeare vocabulary, report filtered fraction
task.fresh_partition: independent Gutenberg audit corpus; never accessed by development

controls: rank-1 shared Tucker matrix bank with free layer coefficients
rank-2 shared Tucker matrix bank with free layer coefficients (primary control)
rank-4 shared Tucker matrix bank with free layer coefficients (upper reconstruction control)
rank-2 shared Tucker matrix bank with circular Mirror layer coefficients

storage.authority: actual serialized torch inference package bytes, including all model tensors, metadata, banks, codes and archive overhead
storage.format: deterministic torch.save state package; all bank/code values FP16, untouched tensors FP32; reconstruct matrices deterministically at load
paid_objects: all layer coefficients or Mirror centers/radii/angles

metrics.primary_quality: mean next-token negative log likelihood on independent Gutenberg audit text after fixed vocabulary filtering
metrics.secondary_quality: development split NLL and matrix reconstruction MSE
metrics.compute: training updates/tokens, compression FLOP proxy and wall time, package reconstruction time, inference examples/sec
metrics.fresh_gate: Per seed, Mirror must be <=0.95x rank-2 Tucker total package bytes and fresh NLL increase <=0.02 nat/token; PROMISING requires 3/3 seeds. FAIL if byte margin misses in >=2 seeds or NLL increase exceeds 0.02 in >=2 seeds.

boundaries: no learned Mirror or online adaptation claim
